name: Uncalibrated instrument / drift
desc: Values may be internally consistent yet systematically biased because of the condition of the measurement system.
detect: Control materials, calibration history, cross-instrument comparison, and uncertainty review.
prevent: Calibration and metrological traceability where applicable; an instrument ID alone is insufficient.

name: Sample or source identity mix-up
desc: Correct information is assigned to the wrong entity, potentially making all derived outputs indefensible.
detect: Sample/run reconciliation, barcode and identifier checks, and custody logs.
prevent: Use persistent internal identifiers and recorded custody events; do not rely on manual renaming as the identity mechanism.

name: Silent coercion during cleaning
desc: Software or a spreadsheet changes values automatically without an explicit failure.
detect: Schema and domain constraints, diffs, round-trip checks, and anomaly rules.
prevent: Scripted, versioned transformations, explicit types, and preservation of raw data.

name: Broken provenance chain
desc: A result exists, but the inputs, activities, agents, and versions that produced it cannot be established.
detect: Provenance-graph completeness checks and detection of orphaned derived artifacts.
prevent: Capture provenance during the work rather than reconstructing it manually after publication.

name: Missing software environment
desc: The same data and code may fail to reproduce the result when dependencies or runtimes differ.
detect: Clean-room reruns and CI-based reproduction checks.
prevent: Environment manifests, lockfiles or containers where appropriate, and versioned code.

name: Undetected file corruption
desc: Bits may change, or a copy may be lost, without a baseline or audit capable of detecting the problem.
prevent: Multiple copies, fixity checks, monitored storage, and restore tests.

name: Ambiguous license or access conditions
desc: Data may exist and be discoverable while reuse remains unclear or impermissible.
detect: Metadata audits of license, access-rights, and conditions fields.
prevent: Explicit machine- and human-readable rights statements and a documented access process.

name: Reference rot / unstable link
desc: A page disappears or its content changes, weakening the ability to revisit the scientific context.
detect: Link checks, PID-resolution monitoring, and archival snapshots where relevant.
prevent: Persistent identifiers, stable landing pages, and repository deposit.
